title: Talking About Your Hobbies
text: In my free time, I like to read books and play basketball. I also enjoy listening to music. What about you?

title: Describing Daily Routine
text: I usually get up at half past seven. After breakfast, I go to school by bus. I have lunch at school and go back home in the afternoon. In the evening, I do my homework and watch TV for a while.

title: Talking About Weather
text: The weather today is really nice. It is warm and the sun is shining. Yesterday it rained all day, but today we can go outside and enjoy the fresh air.

title: Going to the Supermarket
text: I need to buy some milk, eggs, and vegetables for dinner tonight. The supermarket near my house always has fresh food and good prices.

title: Planning a Trip
text: We are going to visit Beijing next month. I want to see the Great Wall and try some local food. I hope the weather will be nice.

title: Cooking at Home
text: I learned to make pasta last weekend. First, I boil the water and cook the noodles. Then I add some tomato sauce and vegetables. It was delicious and easy to make.

title: Talking About Technology
text: I use my phone every day to send messages and check the news. I also like to take photos with it. My phone is very important in my life.

title: Watching a Movie
text: I watched a great movie last night with my friends. It was a comedy and we laughed a lot. The ending was really surprising and touching.

title: Talking About School
text: My favorite subject is English because it is interesting and useful. I have English class three times a week. My teacher is very kind and patient.

title: Describing Your Best Friend
text: My best friend is Li Ming. He is tall and has short black hair. He is very funny and always makes me laugh. We have been friends since primary school.

title: Talking About Health and Exercise
text: I go jogging every morning to stay healthy. I also try to eat more fruits and vegetables. My doctor says I should drink more water and sleep earlier.

title: Celebrating a Festival
text: During the Spring Festival, my family gathers together for a big dinner. We eat dumplings, watch the fireworks, and give red envelopes to children. It is my favorite time of year.

title: Talking About Work Life
text: I work as a salesperson in a clothing store. I help customers find what they need and handle the cash register. I enjoy talking to different people every day.

title: Describing Your Home
text: I live in a small apartment with my parents. It has two bedrooms, a living room, and a kitchen. My favorite place is the balcony because I can see the park from there.

title: Talking About Transportation
text: I usually take the subway to work because it is fast and cheap. Sometimes I ride my bike when the weather is good. Traffic in the morning is always very heavy.

title: 喜欢的颜色
text: My favorite color is blue. I love it very much.

title: 家里的宠物
text: I have a rabbit at home. It is small and cute.

title: 家庭成员
text: There are two people in my family. We love each other.

title: 去超市
text: I want to buy a sandwich and a bottle of water.

title: 谈论天气
text: Today is sunny and warm. Let us go to the supermarket.

title: 周末计划
text: On weekends I play with my friends in the park.

title: 问时间
text: Excuse me, what time is it? It is three o’clock.

title: 上学方式
text: I go to school by bike every morning.

title: 点餐
text: I would like a cup of tea, please. Thank you.

title: 我的房间
text: My room is clean. There is a red bed in it.

title: 介绍家乡
text: I'm from Australia. It is a beautiful place.

title: 问候与介绍
text: Hello, my name is Anna. Nice to meet you.
